title: Grateful Dead Live at Giants Stadium on 1978-09-02
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:106818) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC and Audience (shnid:015822) AUDMC > DAT > WAV > SHN; Recorded by Steve Rolfe with two Sony EMC-33P mics > Sony TC-152 deck 50-60 feet left center from the stage

ai_review.summary: Excellent dusborne matrix captures a post‑hiatus highlight with a scorching Fire, soaring Eyes jam, and a standout Good Lovin'.
ai_review.review: The recording is a high‑quality Dusborne matrix that presents the band in clear, well‑balanced sound. Musically the show shines with what many call the best “Fire” ever played, an electrifying jam after the second verse of “Eyes,” and a killer rendition of “Good Lovin’.” While one reviewer found it merely “good,” the overall vibe is that of a memorable post‑hiatus performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for several standout moments but also described as just good by one reviewer; recording quality is consistently called excellent, yielding a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the Dusborne matrix "excellent" and "outstanding," noting crisp, well‑balanced sound with no reported issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Post‑hiatus energy is high; a notable jam after the second verse of “Eyes” lifts the crowd, and the set maintains momentum despite some reviewers feeling it’s only solid rather than spectacular.

band_member_comments.Drums: Billy Kreutzmann performed with a cast, using his elbow to play conga and energizing the audience.
